sentences.text:
Himanshu Jeswani vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 April,
2025

Author: Gurpal Singh Ahluwalia
Bench: G. S. Ahluwalia

Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Gwl:8862
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

At Gwalior
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice G. S. Ahluwalia
 On The 22nd Of April, 2025
 Miscellaneous Second Appeal No. 20 of 2025
 Himanshu Jeswani
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Harshad Bahrani - Advocate for appellant.
 Shri S.S. Kushwaha - Government Advocate for State.
 Order

This Miscellaneous Second Appeal under Section 71(6) of the Food Safety and Standards Act has been filed against the order dated 28.01.2025 passed by 9th Additional District Judge, Gwalior in RCA No.378/2024 as well as order dated 23.10.2024 passed by Additional District Magistrate,
Gwalior in Case No.Q/Food Safety/59/2023.
2.

The appellant was found guilty for offence under Sections 51 and 52 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short 'FSSA') and penalty of Rs.1 lac was imposed under Section 51 of the FSSA and Rs.1 lac for offence under Section 52 of FSSA.
Upon the appeal, Appellate Court has reduced the penalty to Rs.50,000/- for offence under Section 51 of FSSA and Rs.50,000/- for offence under Section 52 of FSSA.
3 . After arguing the matter at length, counsel for appellant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this miscellaneous second appeal.
It is, accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn.
